journal_name: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

articles.title_en: A Unifying Algebra of Green Consumption Technologies
articles.title_cn: 绿色消费技术的统一代数
articles.abstract_en: This study outlines a unifying model of “green consumption technologies,” which mediate the household production of utility-conferring characteristics and externalities from available market goods. Green consumption technologies are wide-ranging and have been studied in disparate ways in separate literatures on passenger vehicles, home appliances, impure public goods, carbon offsets, and altruism. This study distills these phenomena into a common set of modeling objects, revealing shared features that underpin multiple distinct environmental problems. This study furthermore derives and presents a clean welfare framework for normative evaluation—something that has been underdeveloped in existing work. In particular, it shows how welfare impacts from technological change will depend heavily on trade-offs between consumption and potentially countervailing externalities as well as how those trade-offs are modulated by the underlying consumption technology. In doing so, it provides several important insights for empirical research and generates more lucid policy and management prescriptions across these various literatures.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究勾勒了一个“绿色消费技术”的统一模型，该技术中介了家庭对赋予效用的特征以及来自可用市场品的外部性的生产。绿色消费技术范围广泛，并已在关于乘用车、家用电器、不纯公共品、碳抵消和利他主义的各自文献中以不同方式被研究。本研究将这些现象提炼为一组共同的建模对象，揭示了支撑多个不同环境问题的共同特征。本研究进一步推导并提出了一个清晰的福利框架用于规范性评价——这是现有工作中发展不足的部分。特别地，它展示了来自技术变化的福利影响将如何在很大程度上取决于消费与潜在抵消性外部性之间的权衡，以及这些权衡如何被 underlying 消费技术所调节。在此过程中，它为实证研究提供了若干重要见解，并在这些不同文献中产生了更清晰的政策和管理处方。

articles.title_en: Burden Sharing and Self-Enforcing Climate Agreements
articles.title_cn: 负担分担与自我实施的气候协议
articles.abstract_en: This study analyzes self-enforcing climate agreements in a repeated-game framework in which asymmetric countries emit greenhouse gases over time. In particular, we consider a novel burden-sharing scheme that makes an agreement self-enforcing even when a relatively less patient country participates in the agreement. The long-term stable emission quota that makes the agreement self-enforcing for the largest set of discount factors equalizes the compliance thresholds across countries. We then show that the long-term stable quota satisfies grandfathering as an equity criterion when countries are asymmetric. This implies that low-emitting countries that have developed clean technologies will be reluctant to agree to the scheme, while countries that have invested in adaptation and brown technology are likely to accept the emission quota. Furthermore, an ambitious target level deteriorates the compliance incentives of countries that are allowed to have low emission reduction rates.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究在重复博弈框架下分析了自我实施的气候协议，其中不对称国家随时间排放温室气体。特别地，我们考虑了一种新颖的负担分担方案，即使一个相对缺乏耐心的国家参与协议，也能使协议自我实施。使协议对最大集合的贴现因子具有自我实施性的长期稳定排放配额，使各国的合规阈值相等。然后我们表明，当国家不对称时，长期稳定配额满足作为公平标准的祖父原则。这意味着已开发清洁技术的低排放国家将不愿同意该方案，而投资于适应和棕色技术的国家则可能接受该排放配额。此外，一个雄心勃勃的目标水平会恶化被允许具有低减排率的国家的合规激励。

articles.title_en: International Climate Agreements under the Threat of Solar Geoengineering
articles.title_cn: 太阳地球工程威胁下的国际气候协定
articles.abstract_en: The possibility of overshooting global emissions targets has triggered a public debate about the role solar geoengineering (SGE) - using technologies to reflect solar radiation away from Earth - may play in managing climate change. One major concern is that SGE technologies are relatively cheap, and could potentially be deployed by a single nation (the “free driver”) that could effectively control the global climate. Another concern is that SGE opportunities may alter countries’ incentives to cooperate on abatement. Here we develop a game-theoretic model to analyze how opportunities to deploy SGE impact global abatement and the effectiveness of international environmental agreements (IEAs) on climate change. We show that non-cooperative abatement levels may increase or decrease under the threat of SGE, depending on how damaging the free-driver’s level of deployment is on others. We also show the stability of IEAs that govern abatement is challenged by two competing strategic incentives. One is a familiar free-rider incentive, which is the benefit a country earns by leaving an agreement and lowering its abatement. The other incentive is the benefit a country earns by joining an agreement and increasing abatement in order to motivate the free-driver to reduce its level of deployment. We introduce the term anti-driver to describe this second incentive. Ultimately, we find that if the anti-driver incentives are high enough, the threat of SGE can expand both the depth (i.e., abatement level) and breadth (i.e., participation level) of stable IEAs compared to a world without SGE.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球排放目标可能被超越的可能性引发了关于太阳地球工程（SGE）——利用技术将太阳辐射反射离开地球——在管理气候变化中可能发挥的作用的公开辩论。一个主要担忧是，SGE技术相对便宜，并可能由单一国家（“自由驱动者”）部署，从而可能有效控制全球气候。另一个担忧是，SGE机会可能改变各国在减排上合作的激励。在此，我们建立一个博弈论模型，以分析部署SGE的机会如何影响全球减排以及国际环境协定（IEAs）在气候变化方面的有效性。我们表明，在SGE威胁下，非合作减排水平可能上升或下降，取决于自由驱动者的部署水平对其他国家造成的损害程度。我们还表明，治理减排的IEAs的稳定性受到两种相互竞争的战略激励的挑战。一种是熟悉的搭便车激励，即一个国家通过退出协定并降低其减排所获得的收益。另一种激励是一个国家通过加入协定并增加减排以促使自由驱动者降低其部署水平所获得的收益。我们引入术语反驱动者来描述这第二种激励。最终，我们发现，如果反驱动者激励足够高，与没有SGE的世界相比，SGE威胁可以扩大稳定IEAs的深度（即减排水平）和广度（即参与水平）。

articles.title_en: Positive Rainfall Shocks, Overoptimism, and Agricultural Inefficiency in China
Air Pollution, Cognitive Performance, and the Role of Task Proficiency
articles.title_cn: 空气污染、认知表现与任务熟练度的作用
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the acute effect of air pollution on cognitive performance and how the effect varies with task proficiency using data from over 25,000 individuals and 925,000 plays of a popular online arithmetic training game. To isolate exogenous pollution fluctuation, we interact spatial variation in NOx emissions with thermal inversion episodes. This exogenous variation negatively affects the cognitive performance of proficient players but not of beginners. Instrumenting NO2 pollution with the emissions × inversion interaction, we find that a 1 part per billion concentration increase lowers the number of correct answers of proficient individuals by 0.5% and by 0.3% overall.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用来自超过25,000名个体和一款流行在线算术训练游戏的925,000次游玩的数据，估计空气污染对认知表现的急性效应以及该效应如何随任务熟练度而变化。为了分离外生污染波动，我们将NOx排放的空间变异与逆温事件进行交互。这种外生变异对熟练玩家的认知表现产生负面影响，但对初学者没有影响。以排放×逆温交互项作为NO2污染的工具变量，我们发现浓度每增加1 part per billion，熟练个体的正确答案数量降低0.5%，总体降低0.3%。

articles.title_en: Spatial Microsimulation of Carbon Tax Incidence: An Application to Washington State
articles.title_cn: 碳税归宿的空间微观模拟：以华盛顿州为例
articles.abstract_en: Understanding carbon tax incidence is critical. However, standard approaches for calculating the incidence of subnational policies are prone to inaccuracy due to coarse aggregation. We evaluate an alternative approach: a spatial microsimulation (SMS) method that generates granular household-level incidence estimates. SMS provides unique and more nuanced insights into the distributional consequences of carbon taxes, including across geographies. We demonstrate this method for a recent carbon tax initiative in Washington State and counterfactual variations on its revenue recycling provisions. Comparing across counterfactuals, we pinpoint how different targeting provisions in revenue recycling designs will have disparate consequences for the progressivity/regressivity of the policy package and for the geographic distribution of incidence. We furthermore analyze and discuss potential implications for political economy analysis of carbon taxes. Methodologically, we examine the reliability and robustness of SMS estimates, and we show the superiority of SMS to approaches that aggregate household characteristics over geographic areas.
articles.abstract_cn: 理解碳税归宿至关重要。然而，计算次国家级政策归宿的标准方法由于粗粒度聚合而容易产生不准确。我们评估了一种替代方法：空间微观模拟（SMS）方法，该方法生成细粒度家庭层面的归宿估计。SMS为碳税的分配后果提供了独特且更细致的见解，包括跨地理区域的见解。我们针对华盛顿州近期的一项碳税倡议及其收入循环条款的反事实变体展示了该方法。通过比较不同反事实，我们精确指出了收入循环设计中的不同目标条款将如何对政策方案的累进性/累退性以及归宿的地理分布产生不同后果。我们进一步分析并讨论了碳税政治经济学分析的潜在含义。在方法上，我们检验了SMS估计的可靠性和稳健性，并表明SMS优于将家庭特征在地理区域上聚合的方法。

articles.title_en: When Do Environmental Externalities Have Electoral Consequences? Evidence from Fracking

articles.title_cn: 自愿捐款中的显示性偏好
articles.abstract_en: We propose a method for recovering the compensating variation for a public good based on donation data. People face a take-it-or-leave-it actual donation decision, and the public good is provided if a threshold contribution level is reached. Compensating variation is derived using an expected utility model that accounts for nonparticipation, free riding, and warm glow, and a double hurdle model is used to recover estimates of structural parameters. Monte Carlo simulations suggest that the approach reliably recovers willingness to pay measures with moderate bias, and this bias is reduced when donations are combined with data on the donors’ subjective probabilities that the threshold will be reached. We illustrate the methodology through an empirical application involving the protection of grassland bird habitats.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于捐款数据恢复公共品补偿变差的方法。人们面临一个要么接受要么放弃的实际捐款决策，并且如果达到阈值捐款水平，则提供公共品。补偿变差是通过一个考虑不参与、搭便车和温情效应的期望效用模型推导出来的，并使用双栏模型来恢复结构参数的估计。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该方法能够可靠地恢复支付意愿度量，且偏差适中，当捐款与捐赠者关于达到阈值的 subjective 概率数据相结合时，这种偏差会减小。我们通过一个涉及草原鸟类栖息地保护的实证应用来说明该方法。
